title: Music you can see
intro: Now combine sound and shapes. `after(seconds, function)` runs something later, so a shape can appear exactly when its note plays.
Each note below draws a circle. Higher notes sit higher on the stage.
task: Make your own tune that draws a picture. Change colors, sizes, positions or notes. Then press Copy share link and send it to a friend.
hint: Try a bigger circle for longer notes, or use `rect(x, y, width, height, color)` instead of a circle.
